reviewed_sources.summary: Multiple sorting keys are prioritized in configured order; add the fields as visible columns before sorting.
Template application can select a subset of settings. Updating the existing template overwrites it; distinguish applying from changing the source template.
Role-specific create, apply, edit and removal permissions. Documented limits: 250 checklists per task, 500 items per checklist, item description 2,000 characters.
Edit sent message from context menu or hover toolbar; keyboard E shortcut when enabled. Edits 15 minutes or more after sending show an edited marker.
Personal canvas supports adding, reordering and removing cards; recent items can open from it.
Personal List has direct group and filter controls plus equivalent settings through Customize.
Solo workspace layout available for one-person workspaces; same account can create a separate workspace; policy may require SSO or 2FA.
Chrome extension supports task creation, time tracking, bookmarking, notes and screen capture; setup includes permission review and workspace selection.
Measure by points, tasks, time or percent of capacity; choose color dimension, show/hide weekends and include subtask rollups. Option to open on current selected date.
Color by list, status, priority or dropdown value; configure weekends, week numbers, locations, parent names and title compression.
Click canvas to add existing/new task; new task receives row/date defaults. Drag left/right end to change respective date; drag whole bar shifts both; move across groups changes group value.
Manual automation trigger on individual task; configurable label, icon, color and actions. Permission/plan boundaries apply.
Review comments can be placed on images, PDF or video attachments; comment also appears in task activity, and can be assigned or resolved.
Section lists account settings, storage, sleeping browser tabs, profiles, appearance, locale and high contrast. Section listing only.
Overview links to hierarchy, user roles, customizable features and web/desktop/mobile entry points.
Numeric/date/time computations; TODAY-dependent formulas exclude sorting, filtering, grouping and calculation cards; input permissions constrain output and formula cannot span locations.
Advanced formula editor can use Brain if enabled; text custom fields are not supported as inputs; generated expression results can vary.
Boolean AND, NOT, OR and XOR are documented; syntax errors require feedback.

Function table lists string functions but document explicitly says formula fields cannot manipulate strings and rejects text custom field inputs; treat as documentation ambiguity, test before implementation.
Property manager supports sharing fields across locations, setting permissions, defaults, required and ordering options.
Location-level field applies to descendants; task-type properties available regardless of location. Both can coexist.

Moving upward exposes field to descendants; moving downward hides values outside scope without deleting them and re-expanding restores them. Files, Formula, Progress Auto, Relationship, Rollup and Tasks are excluded.
Quota counts value assignment, multiple labels count separately, creating field/options and linking tasks do not count. Existing data remains available on quota exhaustion.
Vendor recommends separate filtered/grouped list projections for goals and Gantt for dependencies and milestones; advice not measured usability.
Grid cards show progress donut, target count, owner, last update; target count opens editing and card opens details.
Directed blocks and blocked-by relations remain visible after completion; Done counts as completion.
Duration, non-working days and dependency rescheduling cooperate; two of start/due/duration determine the third.
Working-day duration excludes non-working days; elapsed duration counts calendar days; duration editor within date modal.
Milestone is a custom task type represented with diamond icon; type filter and Gantt representation supported.
Owners/admins toggle modular features at workspace or supported Space scope; members can view but guests cannot manage.

patterns.title: Ordered multi-field sort
patterns.documented_behavior: Sort uses ordered keys and requires the relevant fields to be columns.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test priority reorder, stable tie-breaks, hidden field changes, nulls and persistence.

patterns.title: Template apply versus overwrite
patterns.documented_behavior: Selective template settings are applied to destination; updating modifies the template itself. Checklist action permissions vary by role.
patterns.proposed_qa: Confirm affected source versus copy, preview selected settings, validate quotas and permissions.

patterns.title: Personal composable dashboard
patterns.documented_behavior: Personal page contains reorderable removable cards, recent items and configurable personal list grouping/filtering.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test add/remove/reorder, keyboard, personalization persistence, empty state and cross-device context.

patterns.title: Message editing provenance
patterns.documented_behavior: Edit from context menu or hover toolbar; after fifteen minutes, edited marker is shown.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test keyboard and focus, simultaneous edit, timestamp boundary, permissions and audit.

patterns.title: Contextual browser capture
patterns.documented_behavior: Browser extension captures work while browsing with workspace selection and permission review.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test source attribution, private content, denied permissions, offline behavior and duplicate capture.

patterns.title: Workload metric and color encoding
patterns.documented_behavior: Workload units and color dimensions are configurable independently. Layout options control temporal and hierarchical context.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test unit consistency, chart legend, contrast, hidden weekends, rollups and empty rows.

patterns.title: Timeline direct manipulation
patterns.documented_behavior: Canvas placement creates with row/date defaults; drag endpoints edit one date, whole bar edits both, cross-row drag changes grouping.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test pointer and keyboard, cancel, permission, date boundaries, cross-group confirmation and rollback.

patterns.title: Configurable action property
patterns.documented_behavior: Button property invokes task-specific automations; text, icon, color and actions configurable.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test pending, repeat click, scope, permissions, confirmation, errors and audit.

patterns.title: Anchored review and activity mirror
patterns.documented_behavior: Attachment comment also appears in task activity and supports assignment/resolution.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test stable comment identity, media version, anchor coordinate, permission and resolved state.

patterns.title: Property schema by type and location
patterns.documented_behavior: Properties may inherit from location hierarchy or be attached to object type; both are visible in task schema.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test shared identity, duplicate names, move, inheritance and role gating.

patterns.title: Reversible property scope
patterns.documented_behavior: Narrowing field scope hides out-of-scope values without deleting them; widening can restore them. Some field types cannot move.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test preservation, scope visibility and ACL enforcement, query behavior and warning before move.

patterns.title: Property assignment quota
patterns.documented_behavior: Usage counts assigned values, not schema creation; each selected label counts. Data survives limit exhaustion.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test counting, retry idempotency, read access after exhaustion, clear limit messaging.

patterns.title: Computed field input and expression constraints
patterns.documented_behavior: Calculation inputs and permissions are constrained; TODAY() reduces query support. Vendor string-function article has contradictory wording; avoid asserting unsupported manipulation.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test null, invalid types, logic functions, private input, expression syntax and ambiguous string cases.

patterns.title: Goal progress summary and drilldown
patterns.documented_behavior: Goal card combines progress, target count, owner and freshness with target/detail entry points.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test metric denominator, zero targets, stale data, accessible donut alternative and edit permissions.

patterns.title: Dependency relationship persistence
patterns.documented_behavior: Blocker and waiting-on edges remain visible after Done or Closed.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test direction, cycle handling (not established), completion and edge visibility.

patterns.title: Two-input scheduling
patterns.documented_behavior: Any two of start date, due date and duration determine the third; workday vs calendar duration differs.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test holidays, timezone, date precision, edit precedence, invalid range and cascades.

patterns.title: Milestone as typed object
patterns.documented_behavior: Milestone is a task type, not merely a decorative label; icon and filtering reflect type.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test type conversion, filtering, timeline representation and accessible label.

patterns.title: Scoped modular features
patterns.documented_behavior: Admins/owners can enable features globally or per supported Space, while members have view-only access.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test inherited and overridden configurations, permission, disable-with-data and discoverability.

ci_observation.full_suite: 362 passed, 10 failed; regression quality monitor and plugin synchronization

scope: Article and section retrieval; no live product validation or new media inspection.
